intro.zh: 与我们一起工作的导演、编剧、音乐、舞蹈与制作同仁——他们以专业与实验精神，共同撑开舞台的边界。
intro.en: Directors, writers, music and movement artists, producers — collaborators who widen the edge of the stage with craft and experiment.

bio.zh: 中宣部「四个一批」人才；303 戏剧艺术中心艺术总监；惊喜之夜艺术总监；全民戏剧工作坊发起人、总策划。
bio.en: National publicity “Four Batches” talent; artistic director, 303 Drama Art Center; artistic director, Surprise Night; founder and chief planner, National Drama Workshop.

bio.zh: 多次受邀参加荷兰艺术节、比利时艺术节、德国柏林戏剧节、希腊雅典戏剧节、爱丁堡国际艺术节等。
bio.en: Invited repeatedly to Holland Festival, Belgium Arts Festival, Berlin Theatre Festival, Athens Drama Festival, Edinburgh International Festival, among others.

works.zh: 《7080》《8090》《只有一个名字》《聂小倩与宁采臣》《连木》《终极骗局》《生存游戏》
works.en: 7080, 8090, Only a Name, Nie Xiaoqian & Ning Caichen, Lian Mu, The Ultimate Con, The Survivor.

bio.zh: 北爱尔兰作曲家；英格兰艺术委员会合作艺术家；Surge 管弦乐团艺术总监；奥斯特大学作曲博士；伯明翰城市大学研究员（节日与作曲）；伯明翰音乐学院客座讲师（世界融合音乐、作曲工作坊与学生表演项目）；南伯明翰学院客座讲师（世界音乐、流行音乐史、作曲、音乐理论、即兴与表演等）；发行多张 CD，担任多个音乐项目的作曲、编曲与制作人。
bio.en: Northern Irish composer; collaborating artist, Arts Council England; artistic director, Surge Orchestra; PhD in composition, Ulster University; researcher, Birmingham City University (festivals & composition); guest lecturer, Royal Birmingham Conservatoire (world fusion, composition workshops, student performance); guest lecturer, South Birmingham College (world music, pop history, composition, theory, improvisation, performance); multiple CD releases as composer, arranger and producer.

works.zh: 《La Fête》《Valley of Angels》《Live in Birmingham 04》《Thomas Carnduff》《Little Bird》《Love Forgiven》
works.en: La Fête, Valley of Angels, Live in Birmingham 04, Thomas Carnduff, Little Bird, Love Forgiven.

bio.zh: 资深戏剧制作人、影视娱乐营销顾问；中国演出行业协会等机构任职；中央戏剧学院等院校研究生实践导师、客座讲师。
bio.en: Senior theatre producer and film entertainment marketing consultant; roles with China Association of Performing Arts and related bodies; graduate mentor and guest lecturer, Central Academy of Drama and partner institutions.

bio.zh: 毕业于中央戏剧学院；与北京人民艺术剧院合作《茶馆》《雷雨》《原野》等经典剧目，统筹百余场国际国内演出。曾任万达传媒总经理，负责《唐人街探案2》《环太平洋2》《大黄蜂》《权力的游戏》等影片营销。
bio.en: CAFA graduate; worked with Beijing People’s Art Theatre on Teahouse, Thunderstorm, The Wilderness and more — over a hundred domestic and international performances. Former GM, Wanda Media; led marketing for Detective Chinatown 2, Pacific Rim 2, Bumblebee, Game of Thrones, among others.

bio.zh: 青年舞蹈家；中南大学音乐舞蹈系副教授；湖南省舞蹈家协会理事；长沙市舞蹈家协会副主席。
bio.en: Young choreographer and dancer; associate professor, Music & Dance Department, Central South University; council member, Hunan Dancers Association; vice chair, Changsha Dancers Association.

works.zh: 舞剧《君生我未生》；大型歌舞诗《中南故事》；原创剧目十余台，含《湘灵》《大美于心》；原创舞蹈《半条被子》《逆行者》《湘江浴月》《博物馆奇遇记》等。
works.en: Dance drama You Were Born When I Was Not; large-scale song & dance poem Central South Story; 10+ original productions including Xiang Ling and Great Beauty in the Heart; original dances Half a Quilt, The Retrograde, Bathing the Moon in Xiang River, Museum Adventure, and more.

bio.zh: 成都市川剧研究院，国家一级演员。
bio.en: Chengdu Sichuan Opera Research Institute; national first-class actor.

bio.zh: 获奖：第 2 届四川省川剧表演大赛二等奖；四川省首届艺术节「文华奖·个人表演奖」；四川省第三届中青年川剧表演大赛一等奖。
bio.en: Awards: 2nd prize, 2nd Sichuan Province Sichuan Opera Performance Competition; Wenhua Award — Individual Performance, 1st Sichuan Art Festival; first prize, 3rd Sichuan Young & Middle-aged Sichuan Opera Performance Competition.

bio.zh: 导演跨界戏剧节目《武·生》《盗冠袍》《医生》《禹门关》《望娘滩》《梁红玉》等，多次赴美、韩、日、德、新加坡、英、葡、泰、马来西亚等十多个国家文化交流演出。
bio.en: Directed crossover Sichuan opera programmes including Wu Sheng, Stealing the Crown Robe, Doctor, Yumen Pass, Wangniangtan, Liang Hongyu — cultural exchange tours in the US, Korea, Japan, Germany, Singapore, UK, Portugal, Thailand, Malaysia and more.

bio.zh: 格拉斯哥大学戏剧构作与编剧硕士。戏剧构作：长沙原创话剧《女儿 18 我 28》；第二届岳麓山青年戏剧节《古塘湾1930》；2019 格拉斯哥剧本朗读《Mother Grand》。编剧：首部沉浸式互动游戏戏剧《终极骗局》；儿童剧《我不是孙悟空》、悬疑剧《芝居》、短剧《党的光辉永恒》等。
bio.en: MFA in playwriting & dramaturgy, University of Glasgow. Dramaturgy: Daughter 18 Me 28 (Changsha); Gutangwan 1930 (2nd Yuelushan Youth Theatre Festival); Mother Grand (Glasgow script reading, 2019). Playwriting: The Ultimate Con (first immersive interactive game play); I Am Not Sun Wukong, Zhiju, The Party’s Brilliance Is Eternal, among others.

bio.zh: 2020 话剧《每个女人都很作》项目统筹；2020–2021 岳麓山青年戏剧节嘉宾与节目统筹；2019 格拉斯哥国际戏剧节 Surge Festival 实习顾问。英文剧作包括 The Shape of Foreigner、Wedding。
bio.en: Project coordinator, Every Woman Is a Drama Queen (2020); guest & programme coordinator, Yuelushan Youth Theatre Festival (2020–2021); intern consultant, Surge Festival, Glasgow International Festival of Theatre (2019). English plays include The Shape of Foreigner and Wedding.

bio.zh: 艺术节制作人，戏剧制作人、导演、演员；上海乌龙剧团艺术总监；网剧《乌龙事务所》制片人；北京祥云小镇户外公共艺术季、台州府城公共艺术节、乌镇戏剧节古镇嘉年华单元、思南公共空间艺术—上海城市空间艺术节 StArtFestival、上海国际喜剧节户外单元等制作人或负责人；首届安顺屯堡面具节执行制作；第二届上海国际 BBOX 大赛执行顾问；贵阳小剧场戏剧季执行制作；策划上海话剧艺术中心首届「先行」青年创意戏剧节。
bio.en: Festival and theatre producer, director, actor; artistic director, Shanghai Wulong Troupe; producer, web series Wulong Affairs; producer/lead for outdoor art seasons (Xiangyun Town), Taizhou Old Town Public Art Festival, Wuzhen Theatre Festival Carnival, Sinan StArtFestival, Shanghai Comedy Festival outdoor unit; executive producer, Anshun Tunpu Mask Festival; executive advisor, Shanghai International BBOX Competition; executive producer, Guiyang small-theatre season; curator, Shanghai Dramatic Arts Centre “Pioneer” youth festival.

bio.zh: 赴法国学习环境戏剧，作品《当月亮升起的时候…》参演瑟堡艺术节（IN 单元）、奥利亚克艺术节（IN 单元）。
bio.en: Studied environmental theatre in France; When the Moon Rises… presented at Cherbourg and Aurillac festivals (IN programme).

bio.zh: 职业作曲家，文华奖、群星奖获得者；中国音协「全国优秀青年词曲作家高级研修班」第三期学员、「新时代词曲创作领军人物高级研修班」学员；重庆市第四届音协理事；重庆市第三届巴渝文艺新秀暨文艺骨干研修班优秀学员、第二期中青年词曲创作骨干培训班学员；重庆魔钹瑞琶文化传播有限公司法人。
bio.en: Professional composer; Wenhua Award and Stars Award; China Musicians’ Association advanced programmes for young writers and leading contemporary songwriters; council member, 4th Chongqing Musicians Association; outstanding participant, Bayu emerging artists programme and mid-career songwriters training; legal representative, Chongqing Mobo Ruipa Culture Co., Ltd.
